title: EA Skills repository configuration
description: Repository-level settings. Every key is optional; the documented default applies.

name.description: Model name, used in generated documents.

documentation.description: What this model covers and what it is for.

stalenessDays.description: Elements not reviewed within this many days are stale (GOV004, `staleness`).

quoteMatchThreshold.description: Minimum similarity for a provenance quote to count as approximate (PROV004).

factsRoot.description: Directory provenance file references resolve against.

sourcesDir.description: Directory holding the raw source documents.

costModel.description: Optional. Unit rates that turn the debt register's exposure into money. The tool computes the exposure; the operator prices it. Absent, `debt` output is unchanged.

currency.description: Printed beside every amount. Required, because an unlabelled number in a board pack is read in whatever currency the reader assumes.

openDispensationDay.description: Per open dispensation, per day since it was granted.

eolElement.description: Per element referencing a deprecated or retired standard.

duplicateRealization.description: Per realizer beyond the first on one capability.
